reasoning: Shows an hourglass with its top bulb full of sand, universally understood as a sand timer, countdown, or waiting state. It fits concrete tasks about physical timers, Pomodoro/time-tracking setups, timeouts, and 'waiting-for' lists, though it should not be used merely because a task has a deadline or duration. It is less distinct only if the icon set includes empty or half-full hourglass variants.
